verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents an official public MCP endpoint at mcp.helix-db.com that serves query, observability, and admin tools. Those tools are permission-scoped, for example helix_execute_read_query requires database.query.read, and `helix chef` installs a docs MCP as part of agent setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Helix Cloud exposes one public MCP endpoint: `https://mcp.helix-db.com/mcp` Query, observability, and customer administration tools share this endpoint.
helix_execute_read_query: execute exact v3 request_type: "read" JSON; requires database.query.read.
It installs the HelixDB query skills and docs MCP
